title: Teodoro urges ‘peaceful, legal’ settlement of South China Sea row

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Wednesday urged Southeast Asian nations to resolve South China Sea disputes through peaceful and legal means amid shifting regional security conditions. Teodoro made the call as defense leaders gathered in Lapu-Lapu City for the 20th ASEAN Defence Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and the 13th ADMM-Plus on Oct. 28 to 29, 2026 to discuss shared security concerns. “ASEAN was founded on the belief that our strength lies in our diversity. We must therefore not allow our differences to divide us from within,” Teodoro said in his opening remarks. READ: Cebu Asean meetings to […]...
